nodes.summary: Provide the dupfind executable and build contract.
nodes.instructions: Provide the main package at ./cmd/dupfind and ensure the application root builds it with go build ./cmd/dupfind using only the standard library.
nodes.name: Provide the dupfind executable and build contract.

nodes.summary: Parse command options and validate the directory argument.
nodes.instructions: Implement the documented command syntax, --summary, --min-size, help text, and validation of options and the single directory argument. Malformed arguments return exit code 2 and write no standard output. Missing or non-directory paths return exit code 1 and write no standard output. Operational diagnostics go to standard error.
nodes.name: Parse command options and validate the directory argument.

nodes.summary: Find exact duplicate regular files in a directory tree.
provides: duplicate groups from a directory tree
nodes.instructions: Recursively examine regular files, including hidden paths, without following or reporting symbolic links. Ignore zero-byte files and files smaller than the selected minimum size. Group by size before reading contents, then by SHA-256 digest. Skip unreadable files with one warning on standard error and do not change the exit code. Only read examined files; never delete, move, or write anything under the examined directory.
nodes.name: Find exact duplicate regular files in a directory tree.

nodes.summary: Order duplicate groups and paths deterministically.
provides: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
consumes: duplicate groups from a directory tree
nodes.instructions: Order groups by reclaimable bytes descending and then digest ascending. Number groups from 1 in that order. Order paths within each group by byte value and emit paths relative to the requested directory using / separators without a leading ./.
nodes.name: Order duplicate groups and paths deterministically.

nodes.summary: Write the duplicate listing as CSV.
consumes: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
nodes.instructions: Write the default listing to standard output with encoding/csv. Emit the specified header and one row per file in each duplicate group, with lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digests. With no duplicates, emit only the header. Use newline line endings and RFC 4180 field quoting.
nodes.name: Write the duplicate listing as CSV.

nodes.summary: Write duplicate group and reclaimable-space totals.
consumes: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
nodes.instructions: When --summary is selected, emit the specified CSV header and one data row containing the number of duplicate groups, the sum of files minus one per group, and total reclaimable bytes. With no duplicates, emit zero for all totals. Derive the summary from the same duplicate groups as the listing.
nodes.name: Write duplicate group and reclaimable-space totals.

nodes.summary: Provide the project quality test entry point.
nodes.instructions: Provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that runs go vet ./... and go test ./... from the application root. Exit zero only when both commands pass.
nodes.name: Provide the project quality test entry point.

nodes.summary: Pass the supplied duplicate-finder conformance grader.
nodes.instructions: Run the supplied sources/run.sh from the completed application root and require its exit status to be zero. Do not modify, rewrite, regenerate, or substitute the supplied harness.

nodes.summary: Provide the dupfind executable and build contract.
nodes.instructions: Provide the main package at ./cmd/dupfind and ensure the application root builds it with go build ./cmd/dupfind using only the standard library.
nodes.name: Provide the dupfind executable and build contract.

nodes.summary: Parse command options and validate the directory argument.
nodes.instructions: Implement the documented command syntax, --summary, --min-size, help text, and validation of options and the single directory argument. Malformed arguments return exit code 2 and write no standard output. Missing or non-directory paths return exit code 1 and write no standard output. Operational diagnostics go to standard error.
nodes.name: Parse command options and validate the directory argument.

nodes.summary: Find exact duplicate regular files in a directory tree.
provides: duplicate groups from a directory tree
nodes.instructions: Recursively examine regular files, including hidden paths, without following or reporting symbolic links. Ignore zero-byte files and files smaller than the selected minimum size. Group by size before reading contents, then by SHA-256 digest. Skip unreadable files with one warning on standard error and do not change the exit code. Only read examined files; never delete, move, or write anything under the examined directory.
nodes.name: Find exact duplicate regular files in a directory tree.

nodes.summary: Order duplicate groups and paths deterministically.
provides: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
consumes: duplicate groups from a directory tree
nodes.instructions: Order groups by reclaimable bytes descending and then digest ascending. Number groups from 1 in that order. Order paths within each group by byte value and emit paths relative to the requested directory using / separators without a leading ./.
nodes.name: Order duplicate groups and paths deterministically.

nodes.summary: Write the duplicate listing as CSV.
consumes: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
nodes.instructions: Write the default listing to standard output with encoding/csv. Emit the specified header and one row per file in each duplicate group, with lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digests. With no duplicates, emit only the header. Use newline line endings and RFC 4180 field quoting.
nodes.name: Write the duplicate listing as CSV.

nodes.summary: Write duplicate group and reclaimable-space totals.
consumes: ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
nodes.instructions: When --summary is selected, emit the specified CSV header and one data row containing the number of duplicate groups, the sum of files minus one per group, and total reclaimable bytes. With no duplicates, emit zero for all totals. Derive the summary from the same duplicate groups as the listing.
nodes.name: Write duplicate group and reclaimable-space totals.

nodes.name: Provide the project quality test entry point.
